analysis: The supplied changes are documentation only. changelog.d/nemotron-super-media-discovery.md is added, and docs/architecture/hardware-support.md changes its date and adds a Context paragraph (head lines 13-18). The paragraph says the unregistered Super builder requires a live pending LOAD lease and keeps the fixed-workspace concurrency floor. That matches existing hardware-support invariants 5 and 6 and the pending-load permit flow, so no control is weakened in the doc. The changelog describes code that is not in this batch. It covers an opt-in Nemotron Super owner hook, an HTTP image and text path described as using existing auth and loopback SSE, and a CPU PNG/JPEG decoder with EXIF/XMP orientation and bounded geometry. It also covers env-gated MTP speculation, batched decode up to 8 requests, chunked prefill, and an owner-wide prefill lane charge. Several of these touch TB-007, TB-003, A-001 and T-028: decoding consumer-supplied untrusted image bytes, per-request retirement and residual KV or GPU data, and the DoS and memory accounting limits. They also touch T-041 if the prefix cache interacts with the new owner, because the changelog does not say whether it does. None of that source was supplied, so no regression can be asserted. Unit 9bceb6d953b336e2:0 (docs/architecture/inference.md) is metadata only, with no patch or text, so its content is unexamined. The next pass should inspect NemotronSuperLocalBridgeBuilder.swift, the image decoder, the HTTP hook auth and bind address (loopback-only, default-off), request retirement and cancellation wiping, and the pending LOAD lease and memory-ledger charges. It should also check whether the hook bypasses the coordinator E2E-encryption path (A-001, TB-002) and whether the threat model needs an entry for the decoder and hook surface.
